dialogues.speaker: Yundan
dialogues.text: My brother is just a normal fellow at heart, too, though he seems to be doing some sort of extraordinary job at the moment... Honestly, I think he enjoys being all secretive and deliberately mystifying about it.

dialogues.speaker: Yundan
dialogues.text: I don't really understand the rest of my relatives in the city to be honest. I wonder when they'll come and visit...
